```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("aod")
library(aod)
```
```{r}
msleep <- glimpse(msleep)
storms <- storms
lizards <- lizards
```


**1.**
```{r}
mmls12hrs<-filter(msleep, sleep_total>=12)
head(mmls12hrs)
```
**2.** 
```{r}
msleep%>%
  mutate(percent_day_awake = (sleep_total/24) *100)%>%
  select(percent_day_awake, everything())

```

**3.**
```{r}
storms%>%
  group_by(year)%>%
  summarise(num_storms=n())
```
**4.**
```{r}
storms%>%
  filter(wind>50)%>%
  arrange(desc(wind))
```
